# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 2 tokens; Text — 1 token; Fills and status backgrounds — 2 tokens; Borders and rings — 2 tokens; Charts — 3 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 12 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 13 tokens; Radius — 4 tokens; Shadow — 1 token.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--canvas, #f6f7f8);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--canvas, #0e1115);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #f6f7f8;
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--canvas` | #f6f7f8 | #0e1115 | Page background behind everything. Dark is a blue-black, never pure black. |
| `--surface` | #ffffff | #161a20 | Cards, inputs, nav bar, menus. One step lighter than `canvas` in dark so cards lift without shadows. |

## Color · Text

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--ink, #14181f);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--ink, #e9edf1);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #14181f;
```

### Tokens (1)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--ink` | #14181f | #e9edf1 | Main text on `canvas`, `surface`, `primary-soft` and every `-soft` status fill: 11:1 or more in both themes. |

## Color · Fills and status backgrounds

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--on-primary, #ffffff);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--on-primary, #062420);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #ffffff;
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--on-primary` | #ffffff | #062420 | Text and icons on a `primary` or `primary-hover` fill: 6.4:1 light, 7.5:1 dark. White in light, deep teal in dark, so never write `text-white` on a primary button. Added beyond the brief. |
| `--on-danger` | #ffffff | #2a0909 | Text on a `danger-solid` or `danger` fill: 6.5:1 light, 6.9:1 dark. Added beyond the brief. |

## Color · Borders and rings

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--border, #e3e6ea);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--border, #272d35);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #e3e6ea;
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--border` | #e3e6ea | #272d35 | Card borders and dividers only. Decorative (about 1.25:1 in both themes): never the only edge of something you tap. |
| `--border-strong` | #7b8696 | #6e7a8a | Input, code-box and secondary-button borders: light 3.7:1 on `surface`, 3.4:1 on `canvas`; dark 4.0:1 and 4.3:1. |

## Color · Charts

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--chart-1, #00917f);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--chart-1, #20a393);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #00917f;
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--chart-1` | #00917f | #20a393 | First data series in charts (bars, lines). A brighter teal than `primary` because chart marks need chroma to read as colour. Charts only: never text, never buttons. |
| `--chart-2` | #e8710a | #d9752a | Second series. Orange, picked to stay apart from teal for colour-blind readers (validated: worst pair ΔE 11.4 light, 13.0 dark). Not a status colour. |
| `--chart-3` | #6a5ad8 | #9085e9 | Third series. Charts never show more than three; fold the rest into "Other". Values and labels stay in `ink` / `muted`, never in a series colour. |

## Color · Palette ramps and brand

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--primary, #0b6b63);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--primary, #4fc1b4);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #0b6b63;
```

### Tokens (12)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--primary` | #0b6b63 | #4fc1b4 | Main buttons, links, focus ring, selected items. As text: light 6.4:1 on `surface`, 5.9:1 on `canvas`; dark 8.0:1 and 8.7:1. |
| `--primary-hover` | #084e48 | #7ad3c9 | Hover and pressed fill for anything painted `primary`. Light darkens, dark lightens; `on-primary` reads 9.6:1 / 9.4:1 on it. |
| `--primary-soft` | #e3f1ef | #123532 | Selected rows, info alerts, secondary-button hover. Background only: `ink` (15.3:1 / 11.3:1) or `primary` (5.5:1 / 6.1:1) on it. |
| `--disabled` | #e3e6ea | #272d35 | Fill of disabled buttons (the brief's #E3E6EA in light). Put `muted` text on it: 6.2:1 / 6.3:1. |
| `--muted` | #4a5361 | #a6b0bc | Secondary text, hints, captions on `canvas` and `surface`: 7.2–7.8:1 light, 7.9–8.6:1 dark. |
| `--success` | #14532d | #86e0a6 | Healthy badge text and icon, success message text. On `success-soft`: 8.3:1 light, 9.0:1 dark. |
| `--success-soft` | #dcfce7 | #11301f | Healthy badge and success message fill. |
| `--warning` | #7a3e06 | #f5c566 | Low stock badge text and icon, warning alert text. On `warning-soft`: 7.5:1 light, 8.5:1 dark. |
| `--warning-soft` | #fef3c7 | #3a2b0c | Low stock badge and warning alert fill. |
| `--danger` | #7f1d1d | #fca5a5 | Out of stock and Expired badge text, error message text, destructive-button hover fill. On `danger-soft`: 8.2:1 / 8.3:1. |
| `--danger-soft` | #fee2e2 | #3d1717 | Out of stock / Expired badge and error message fill. |
| `--danger-solid` | #b91c1c | #f27a7a | Destructive button fill; field error text, icon and border. As text on `surface` 6.5:1 in both themes; on `danger-soft` 5.3:1 / 5.9:1. |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 600 40px/48px "Inter", "Noto Sans Arabic", system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.02em;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-text-display); letter-spacing: -0.02em;
font-family: var(--font-sans);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line, italic, letter spacing | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text-display` | `.text-display`, `--text-text-display` | 40px / 48px, letter-spacing -0.02em | 600 | `sans` | Landing-page hero headline and the big number in a stat card. One per screen. |
| `text-heading` | `.text-heading`, `--text-text-heading` | 30px / 36px, letter-spacing -0.02em | 600 | `sans` | Screen title: Welcome back, Check your email, Dashboard. |
| `text-title` | `.text-title`, `--text-text-title` | 20px / 28px | 600 | `sans` | Card titles, section titles, menu headings. |
| `text-body` | `.text-body`, `--text-text-body` | 16px / 24px | 400 | `sans` | Everything people read: descriptions, form text, table rows. Never smaller in inputs (iOS zooms below 16px). |
| `text-small` | `.text-small`, `--text-text-small` | 14px / 20px | 400 | `sans` | Hints, secondary lines in a row, footer text. |
| `text-caption` | `.text-caption`, `--text-text-caption` | 13px / 18px | 500 | `sans` | Status badges and tiny meta (Sample data). Never for sentences. |
| `text-label` | `.text-label`, `--text-text-label` | 14px / 20px | 500 | `sans` | Form labels and nav links. Added beyond the brief's scale so labels stay consistent. |

### Families

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sans` | `--font-sans` | `"Inter", "Noto Sans Arabic", system-ui, sans-serif` |

## Spacing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 4px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (13)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-1` | 4px | Icon-to-text gap inside badges; tightest nudge. |
| `--space-2` | 8px | Label to input; icon to label in buttons; between code boxes. |
| `--space-3` | 12px | Inside alerts and form messages; between a row's two lines. |
| `--space-4` | 16px | Page side padding on phones; card padding on phones; between form fields. |
| `--space-6` | 24px | Card padding from 640px up; gap between cards; button side padding. |
| `--space-8` | 32px | Between page sections on phones; page side padding from 1024px. |
| `--space-12` | 48px | Between landing sections on phones. Added beyond the brief's list for page rhythm. |
| `--space-16` | 64px | Between landing sections from 768px. Added beyond the brief's list for page rhythm. |
| `--control-height` | 52px | Height of every button and text input (the brief allows 48–52px; 52 keeps thumbs comfortable). Tailwind: `h-control`. |
| `--icon-sm` | 16px | Icons inside badges and chart flags. Tailwind: `size-4`. |
| `--icon-md` | 20px | Icons in buttons, fields, alerts, form messages. Tailwind: `size-5`. |
| `--icon-lg` | 24px | Menu toggle, app-nav icons, empty-state tiles. Tailwind: `size-6`. |
| `--tap-min` | 44px | Smallest tap target: icon buttons, Show/Hide, text links, menu toggle. Tailwind: `min-h-tap min-w-tap`. |

## Radius

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--radius-control: 8px) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--radius-control), so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (4)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--radius-control` | 8px | Inputs, code boxes, alerts, form messages, the logo tile. |
| `--radius-card` | 12px | Cards, stat cards, the auth card, the mobile menu sheet. |
| `--radius-button` | 8px | Buttons. Same as `radius-control` today; its own token so per-business theming can round buttons without touching inputs. |
| `--radius-pill` | 999px | Status badges and the Sample data tag. |

## Shadow

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--shadow-card: none) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--shadow-card), so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (1)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--shadow-card` | none | No shadows in Ledger Clean, in either theme: cards are edged by a 1px `border`. Kept as a token so code can say `shadow-card` and stay correct if that ever changes. |
